description: Machine-agnostic runtime for Bear Necessities CAD builds. Nothing here may hard-code a home directory. Every value can be overridden by the matching BN_* environment variable so the same checkout builds on Conor's laptop and on the Mac mini.

paths._comment: claude_root is discovered by walking up until both sibling projects are found. The rest are relative to it.

services._fusion_mcp_url_comment: auto = discover it. Fusion's MCP port is NOT stable: it moved from 27182 to 27180 after a crash-relaunch and every tool pinned to the old number reported Fusion missing while it was running fine. Set a literal URL here only to force one.

models._comment: Roles, not machines. The mini may satisfy these with larger models; preflight checks the roster actually loaded rather than assuming.
